1457 blurbs · generated November 24, 2026 · a living archive; new batches get appended. Blank cards marked NEEDS DATA are awaiting missing fields. The document checklist covers literal paperwork to submit with the application; background check, fingerprinting, notarization, and bond are shown separately as process requirements, not documents. Checklists marked "standard baseline" fill in when no specific documents were listed for that town — they default to a valid government ID/driver's license and the rep's company badge, not a town-confirmed requirement. "Jurisdiction includes" notes name unincorporated hamlets/CDPs covered by that town's own permit — incorporated villages within a town are excluded unless independently confirmed, since villages often run their own separate permitting. Office addresses (where one is on file) show directly under the town name. All of this is auto-extracted or research-verified — spot-check before relying on it as authoritative. PDF export needs an internet connection to load; blurb/checklist browsing and copying work fully offline.
